name: Air Cup Kit - Tankless Front Kit
desc: This beauty of an air cup suspension provides the ability to raise your car up to 2 inches at a moments notice AND have the reliability/trackability of a coilover setup. This will allow you to avoid obstacles on the road to protect your investment. Additionally, Kuya will exchange the size to fit your coilovers. If you need a set of coilovers, this bid INCLUDES a discount on a new set of coilovers! Check it out at Kuya Auto's site!

name: RFY NSX Racing Oil Pan
desc: This upgraded racing oil pan is a must have for every NSX owner. It is made from aluminum die-casting and increases oil capacity by approximately 1.4 qts. Designed to support extended driving sessions, it helps manage the peak oil temperatures of the high-heat C30-series engines commonly used in motorsports. Additionally, the included anti-slosh plate addresses one of the NSX's known weaknesses—oil pressure drop during right-hand turns—by minimizing oil mist contamination into blow-by gas and stabilizing oil delivery under high G-forces. Check it out on the Valiants Racing site!

name: NSX 100% full Carbon Fiber Replacement Exterior Side Body Vent
desc: A set of full 100% carbon fiber center replacement exterior side vents for your 1991+ NSX. Not only are these new direct replacement side vent trims super light weight and strong, they look AMAZING and guaranteed to fit perfectly without any broken tabs! NO CORE EXCHANGE NEEDED. Get more info on the Euro Boutique site!

name: Acura NSX (NA1 / NA2) 1991–2005 Subframe Replacement Bushings: Front
desc: Factory subframe bushings deteriorate over time, leading to cracking, slop, and excessive suspension deflection regardless of mileage. Honda does not sell replacement bushings separately—requiring the purchase of expensive complete subframe beams. Enter Pride Exhaust, bringing you a solution that replaces worn factory rubber bushings, resisting dry rotting and cracking under load. You can learn more at the Pride Exhaust site!

name: Acura NSX (NA1 / NA2) 1991–2005 Subframe Replacement Bushings: Rear
desc: Factory subframe bushings deteriorate over time, leading to cracking, slop, and excessive suspension deflection regardless of mileage. Honda does not sell replacement bushings separately—requiring the purchase of expensive complete subframe beams. Enter Pride Exhaust, bringing you a solution that replaces worn factory rubber bushings, resisting dry rotting and cracking under load. You can learn more at the Pride Exhaust site!

name: Acura NSX (NC1) 2017–2022 Lower Intercooler Hose Set
desc: Factory rubber intercooler hoses are soft and the worm-gear clamps are a known weak point on the 2nd Gen NSX—even on stock-boost vehicles. Under high boost pressures OEM hoses can stretch, swell, or completely come loose under load. This can even trigger limp mode on the road, or the track. Pride has a solution engineered for track reliability and high-boost consistency, their direct-replacement silicone intercooler hose kit locks your charge pipes in place permanently. You can find out more on the Pride Exhaust site!

name: Acura NSX (Targa) 1995–2005 Burnt Titanium Engine Bay Prop Rod
desc: Replace your boring factory engine hatch prop with custom burnt titanium crafted specifically for show display and weight reduction. No two are the same but they vary between more of a blue color to a purple. Direct Fit: Designed specifically for 1995–2005 Acura NSX (NA1/NA2) Targa Top Engine Covers. You can find out more on the Pride Exhaust site!

name: Wildlife Photography Tour with Dick Vautrinot
desc: Join Dick Vautrinot on a beautiful journey to photograph bald eagles, raptors and shorebirds on a beautiful "Old Florida" lake with picturesque backdrops. The lake has resident eagles that stay year-round. They host an abundance of bald eagles, ospreys, owls, herons, kingfishers, hawks, kestrels, woodpeckers, egrets, ibis and other shorebirds. The tour is held aboard their 24ft pontoon boat, and with over 45 yrs of boat and guiding experience, you will be in the right light to capture great images of "birds-in-flight"! You can find out more on Dick Vautrinot's site!

name: ScienceofSpeed Brake Master Cylinder Brace, NSX 1991-99 (Left Hand Drive, original ABS)
desc: This CAD-optimized and 4-axis machined aluminum brace reduces the movement of the master cylinder by more than 50% by supporting the master cylinder as the pedal is depressed while still allowing a slight amount of movement for compliance. The result is an improved brake feel, giving the driver confidence at the braking limit. You can learn more at the ScienceofSpeed site!

name: ScienceofSpeed NSX-R Style Chassis Reinforcement Braces, NSX 1991-05
desc: The 2002 NSX-R features two chassis-strengthening reinforcement bars at the tips of the front frame rails. These chassis bars increase structural rigidity and dynamic toe change during aggressive driving resulting in increased handling sharpness and response. Unfortunately, the supply of factory parts has dried up and future availability is unknown. ScienceofSpeed has reverse-engineered the factory brace and has created their own extrusion that replicates the factory shape. You can learn more at the ScienceofSpeed site!

name: KTuner Flash V2 Touch (17-22 NSX)
desc: The KTuner Flash V2 Touch is a device that reflashes the factory ECU in the 2017-22 NSX to increase performance by more than 40 - 130+ horsepower, depending on fuel used (91, 93, 98, or E40). Included is a touchscreen programming module that reads the software version on your NSX and uploads maps with higher performance targets. All factory emissions components and engine safety functions are retained. See more details on the ScienceofSpeed site!
